items.title: Loren Schoenberg interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 14, 2019
items.q: I eventually became his personal manager

ctx.x: About 15 or so. Yeah. And one last thing that was probably a real key component of all these things in terms of getting into school and becoming more professional was that at the Jazz Museum one of Jack Bradley’s closest friends was the cornetist Ruby Braff. And Ruby was a real character and I eventually became his personal manager and that’s another story. But Ruby heard me play the piano at the museum, as much as I could play, and he kind of said you know it’s pretty bad he says, but you know you’ve got some…
studio. So if you put all that together it starts to give you a picture of where I was when I went to college.
